description: Follows al-Khwarizmi in Abbasid Baghdad through the classification and geometric completion of quadratic equations, Indian place-value arithmetic, astronomical tables and geographical coordinates, distinguishing his systematization from earlier mathematics and later Latin transmission.

context.note: The reign is an anchored context period in the narration, not al-Khwarizmi’s uncertain birth/death dates. His name suggests Khwarazm, but the text does not establish his birthplace there.
